stem:
Farhan holds three sheets up to a desk lamp: a clear glass pane, greased butter paper, and a wooden board. Through the clear glass pane he sees objects clearly. Through the greased butter paper he sees objects, but not clearly. Through the wooden board he cannot see objects at all.

Which classification is correct?

options.text: Clear glass pane — transparent; greased butter paper — translucent; wooden board — opaque.
Clear glass pane — translucent; greased butter paper — transparent; wooden board — opaque.
Clear glass pane — opaque; greased butter paper — translucent; wooden board — transparent.
Clear glass pane, greased butter paper, and wooden board are all transparent.

teacher.key_rationale: Seen clearly through → transparent; seen but not clearly → translucent; not seen at all → opaque. Swapping labels or calling all three transparent mismatches those observations.
